name: SubTandem
description: A powerful plugin for real-time AI-powered bilingual subtitle translation.

permissionDescriptions.network-request: Connect to the authenticated loopback transport and style picker helpers. Configured or edited endpoints may receive subtitle-free model-list requests. Clicking Test sends the current draft endpoint a fixed subtitle-free connection probe that may be billed; it neither saves an entered key nor enables the Profile. The default DeepSeek root at api.deepseek.com and default Claude root at api.anthropic.com may receive these requests before the Profile is enabled, including without an API key. Only the globally enabled Profile revision receives nearby subtitle text and the exact target language. The service infers source language inside the translation request; short, unknown-source, and already-target-language text is still sent and may be billed. A Claude-compatible service that explicitly rejects structured output may receive one additional schema-free retry and may bill it.
permissionDescriptions.file-system: Read the selected text subtitle from local media or an external subtitle and execute the bundled transport, subtitle extractor, and style picker helpers. Store Profile settings and authenticated encrypted API keys with Secure Enclave-bound recovery material in a plugin-private file. Only the current editing drawer can reveal a saved API key; saving its empty field clears it. Required hardware protection unavailable: nonempty save or saved-key use fails. Upgrading the plaintext format clears API keys while preserving settings and valid selection; re-enter them as needed. Cleanup covers managed copies, not APFS/Time Machine snapshots or other backups; rotate old API keys. Back up the complete file with paired recovery material; recovery requires the original device, user and valid system keys and is not guaranteed. Remove temporary extracted subtitles after use. Remote and graphic embedded subtitles are not read.
permissionDescriptions.video-overlay: Display the current translated subtitle in a local non-interactive translation overlay.
